description: Defines an enum VoiceOverlayTextFormatting with static methods for computing text differences and creating attributed strings for voice overlay UI components.

methods.name: delta(after:current:)
methods.description: Returns the substring of current after the committed prefix if present; otherwise returns current.

methods.name: makeAttributed(committed:volatile:isFinal:)
methods.description: Creates an NSAttributedString combining committed and volatile texts with different styles based on isFinal.
